scope: Bounded inert fixture-only assurance DAGs, external result assertions, evidence eligibility/status events, prerequisite invalidation and finding-bound final reconciliation.
schema_identity: One additive codex.assurance.v1 envelope; kinds plan, history, recommendation. Results and evidence status transitions are history events, not additional schemas.
validation_boundary: An installed core-validated Draft exemplar is copied by pure functions. All imported assurance artifacts receive bounded structural, semantic, binding, integrity and replay validation. Only the continuation adapter reads the installed contract resource. Procedure registry entries are inert supplied data; no procedure, command, target discovery, network or subprocess is invoked.
dag: Technical verification, independent reproduction and institutional audit are distinct declared node kinds. Dependencies are explicit, with stable unique node IDs and no cycles/missing dependencies. Audit need not depend on reproduction. Required trusted independence remains blocked because fixture names cannot authenticate identity.
events: UUIDv4 identities, ordered sequence and predecessor digests; explicit prior result digest for retry and prior evidence status digest for status events. Earlier events remain unchanged. Current result assertions are ACTIVE or SUPERSEDED; evidence statuses are exactly ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, REVOKED, DISPUTED, STALE, UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility and applicability are separate unverified assertions. Unknown critical eligibility blocks.
invalidation: Current prerequisite proofs include bound result, evidence-state and originating evidence-event revision digests. Restoring identical status fields/reason cannot erase an intervening invalidation. Execution exemptions preserve dependency blockers and dependency-sensitive proofs, so invalidation/replacement propagates through exempt bridges. Candidate/context drift reopens required readiness and final recommendation; new binding requires a new plan. Resume recomputes the exact pending node's dispatch prerequisites, never clears it using strings or flags.
findings: Final review is recomputed from original outputs and relation inputs. Every finding, original wording, attribution, dissent and relation remains in the original-review ledger. The sole supported nonmutating disposition is REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE with route=nonmutating; its explicit rejection rationale must occur in both rotated followup and bound result evidence. It also requires original-finding coverage through review.remediation_adequacy, exact original requirement digest and explicit source-bound dissent handling. Ledger meaning is fixture-only rejection recommendation, not authorized adjudication. Contradictions require both endpoint dispositions, not relation deletion, averaging or majority. FIXED has route=proposed-mutation and stays unresolved, never executed. The retain route makes no formal disposition. Other formal disposition types remain unsupported and reject.
authority: Structural limits are always fixture_only=true, identity_assurance=unverified, authority=none, approval=false, activation=false, full_convergence_model=unsupported. CONVERGED_FOR_AUTHORIZED_DECISION is only a fixture recommendation for a separate authorized decision, not such a decision.
resource_limits: One MiB per individual assurance artifact, bounded nesting and 63-bit integers before serialization, 32 nodes/procedures, 128 events and bounded lists. The continuation adapter inherits core.MAX_BYTES (currently 64 MiB) for aggregate continuation/attachments/payload/envelope while independently enforcing the unchanged one-MiB assurance-artifact budget. Per-node positive byte/attempt caps also enforced. No new dependencies.
trust_limits: Digests detect accidental corruption and stale caches, not hostile complete resealing. Provenance, actor names, external results, eligibility and response observations are assertions, not authenticated operational evidence or semantic proof. No numerical convergence score or sensitivity proof is implemented.
acceptance: Reject cycles, mixed bindings, unknown procedures, identity elevation, duplicate results and invalid predecessor retries
Reopen downstream readiness on revoked/disputed evidence, unknown critical eligibility, result replacement and candidate/context drift
Preserve minority findings and original contradictions through fixture-only dispositions
Round-trip through existing continuation/storage without a second store
Retain exact source-only test and validation evidence, distinct from historical installed-wheel evaluation
rollback: Remove additive attachments in a newly previewed existing continuation successor; preserve prior events and user bytes. No activation, destructive migration, automatic rollback, approval or G5 claim.
